Trump Campaigns for Republican Ally in New York Governor's Race

Former President Donald Trump campaigned for Republican candidate Lee Zeldin in New York's gubernatorial race, aligning with Zeldin's political playbook. Trump's involvement has been noted in the context of the midterm elections, with one report suggesting he played a "race card" by referencing Somalis in Minnesota. The campaign's descent into "turmoil" has also been highlighted.
